📖 How to use

  1. Paste your messy text.
  2. Tick the cleanups you want and set tab width.
  3. The cleaned text appears live below.
  4. Check the before/after stats, then copy it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Does it fix tabs and Windows line endings?

Yes — tabs become spaces at your chosen width (2, 4 or 8) and Windows CRLF line endings become plain LF.

What does “collapse blank lines” do?

Keep max 1 turns any run of blank lines into a single blank line; Keep max 2 allows two. Off leaves them alone.

Is my text sent anywhere?

No. Everything runs locally in your browser — your text is never uploaded or stored.
